Row.Text: "I protect thee with this flame, and I drive away the foe and the sand from thy feet."
"There is another world, but it is in this one."
"Do nothing which is of no use."
"After the assembly gathered, the elders gave their answer."
"The unexamined life is not worth living."
"An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth."
"God, with such splendid irony, granted me books and night at one touch."
"Those who delight to attack and to display their valour and fealty should be formed in companies."
"An army is a miniature of the society which produces it."
"The dogs bark, but the caravan moves on."
"Skill is handed down to me from my ancestors in a perpetual line of accumulated wisdom."
"Remain less interested in who we imagine ourselves to be than in what we can do for one another."
"All the world's a stage, and all the men and women merely players."
